Scenario fixture: keyboard-only-event-handlers (RGAA 7.3.1)

Each target has a stable id of the form koh_case_NN. RGAA 7.3.1 asks that an element with a scripted handler works with the keyboard and with any pointing device. The rule asks about key handlers with no click or pointer handler beside them.
